meaning:
συν-σχηματιζω (Rec. συσ-),
(σχῆμα),
to conform to (Arist.). Pass., to be conformed to, conform oneself to: Rom.12:2, 1Pe.1:14.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of…
as children of obedience, not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,
